description: Plan S27 held-out follow-up set v2, written 2026-11-28 and committed before any resolver or LLM run on it. Same format and scoring as followup_subjects_v1.json: 'gold_subject' must appear in the web text (plural/hyphen-insensitive; any one of 'gold_any' also counts). 'must_not_anchor' cases are topic switches whose web text must NOT contain the prior subject. New phrasings of the S9 residual shapes (list references, facet nouns, facet questions about something else, multi-hop referents, statement openers without an -ing verb), other follow-up shapes, and topic switches.
